label: LLM Stream
description: AI language model completion whose reply streams live: each text delta is sent onto the stream bus the moment the model produces it, and the whole reply then pulses on the normal ports. Same provider/params/historyFile/tools wiring as the LLM node; use this one when a consumer should see the text as it is generated. A failure after the stream has opened fails the run, so a reader never mistakes a cut-off stream for a finished one.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The prompt to send, appended as the newest user message. Optional when a `historyFile` is wired (a tool-result round re-enters with the conversation alone).

inputs.name: historyFile
inputs.description: The conversation so far, kept in a stored file (a previous call's or a Chat Message node's `historyFile` output, or a file holding `[]` to start one that later runs will continue: store it in the project scope). This call's turn is added to this same file, in place, and the file comes out on `historyFile`. Unwired, the call starts from no conversation.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this prompt: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: The provider (wire an OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Custom Provider node's output): which service, which model, whose credential the call spends.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Optional LlmParams node carrying the sampling settings (system prompt, temperature, ...). Unwired, the defaults apply.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Tool declarations the model may call: one LLM Tool node's output, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolChoice
inputs.label: Tool choice
inputs.description: Only used when tools are wired: auto lets the model decide, required forces a call, none forbids one.

inputs.name: autoCache
inputs.label: Automatic prompt caching
inputs.description: On: when the conversation carries no cache mark, the request marks the system message and the last message before this call's new turn, so a chain of calls reuses its stable prefix. The marks live on the request alone: the `historyFile` keeps the conversation as written, so the next call in the chain places its own. A conversation that already carries marks (Chat Message's `cacheBreakpoint`) is sent as placed.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: The live text: one 'delta' message per generated fragment, in order; the bus closing is the end of the reply. The bus metadata carries the serving model's name.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The whole reply, once generation finishes.

outputs.name: historyFile
outputs.description: The conversation including this call, kept in a file: the `historyFile` that came in, with this call's user message and reply added to it in place (same file, next version), or, when none came in, a new file holding this turn, kept past the run. Wire it into the next call's or Chat Message node's `historyFile`. Left unwired with no file in, the call is a one-shot and keeps nothing.

outputs.name: toolCalls
outputs.description: The tool calls the model made, if any. Pulses only when the model called tools; append each result with a Chat Message node (role: tool) and wire the `historyFile` back into the next LLM call. A call left without an answer (the run stopped before its result was appended) is answered `cancelled` by the next call on its own, so the conversation keeps working.
